Title: 496099-2026: France – Construction work for sports facilities – CONSTRUCTION WORKS FOR THE NEW SAVARIERES SPORTS FACILITY
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The new construction of a sports hall is generally relevant, as sports buildings often have long-span structures. However, the size and structural details are not apparent from the title/description, therefore only moderate relevance.
titel: Construction of the new Savarières sports facility (new Savarières gymnasium)
kurzbeschreibung: In Saint-Sébastien-sur-Loire near Nantes, a new sports complex with a gymnasium and associated outdoor facilities is being built. The tender covered all construction works from shell construction, timber structure and building envelope to sports flooring, building services, PV system and landscaping.
wettbewerb_art: Award of construction works (open procedure) for a new sports hall
gewinner: Several construction companies per trade (including LEGENDRE LOIRE, BRIAND CONSTRUCTION BOIS, PIGEON TP LOIRE ANJOU, OUEST ETANCHE, MIROITERIE 35, AC METALLERIE, FRADIN SARL, LE GAL COMISO, SRS, OUEST DECOR, OTIS, MARTY SPORTS, VALLOIS, SAS AMIAUD, VENDEE FLUIDES ENERGIES, ENTECH SE, TRAFORDYN, SPORTINGSOLS)
gewinner_rolle: Construction companies / specialist contractors for individual lots (civil works, shell construction, timber structure, building envelope, fit-out, MEP, sports flooring, outdoor facilities)
gewinner_kontakt: Total value of all awarded contracts: 5945037.81 EUR
projektbeteiligte:
Ville de Saint Sébastien sur Loire – public contracting authority/client
PIGEON TP LOIRE ANJOU – construction company, Lot 0001 VRD (earthworks and infrastructure works)
LEGENDRE LOIRE – construction company, Lot 0002 shell construction
BRIAND CONSTRUCTION BOIS – construction company, Lot 0003 timber structure
OUEST ETANCHE – construction company, Lot 0004 waterproofing
MIROITERIE 35 – construction company, Lot 0005 aluminium external windows
AC METALLERIE – construction company, Lot 0006 metal construction/steelwork
FRADIN SARL – construction company, Lot 0007 internal walls/insulation
LE GAL COMISO – construction company, Lot 0008 suspended ceilings
SRS – construction company, Lot 0009 floor and wall coverings
OUEST DECOR – construction company, Lot 0010 painting works
OTIS – construction company, Lot 0011 lifts
MARTY SPORTS – construction company, Lot 0012 sports equipment
VALLOIS – construction company, Lot 0013 landscaping
SAS AMIAUD – construction company, Lot 0014 heating/ventilation/sanitary
VENDEE FLUIDES ENERGIES – construction company, Lot 0015 electrical installations
ENTECH SE – construction company, Lot 0016 photovoltaics
TRAFORDYN – construction company, Lot 0017 geothermal probes
SPORTINGSOLS – construction company, Lot 0018 sports flooring
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Medium-sized new construction of a sports hall/sports facility, generally within sbp’s “Sports” topic spectrum
- Structural design was not part of this construction works tender and was presumably awarded earlier
- Project size and complexity appear moderate, with no indications of exceptionally long-span or iconic structures
- Location outside the DACH region and without a strategic key role, therefore limited acquisition relevance
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in France, checking engineer services according to the German system are not applicable
- Construction works have already been awarded, no separate tender for independent structural checking is apparent
- Sports hall presumably rather conventional, with no indication of particularly complex or high-risk structures that would justify international checking
baukosten_erklaerung: Derived total value of all awarded contracts (EUR 5.945 million) minus rough shares for MEP, PV, geothermal, outdoor facilities and fit-out; rough estimate of the pure building structure (cost groups 300/400) at around EUR 4.5 million
naechste_schritte: No active step required. Document the project internally only as a reference for French sports hall construction tenders; no approach to the winners or the client is planned, as structural design and construction works have already been comprehensively awarded.
notes: This is a construction works tender, not a planning or architectural competition. Structural design is not mentioned in the TED text and is likely to have been commissioned beforehand. Lots 05 BARDAGES and 08 MENUISERIES INTERIEURES AGENCEMENT are awarded separately according to the procedure text, but are only marginally relevant for sbp. Due to the already completed awards and the foreign location, neither cooperation with the winning team in structural design nor a role as checking engineer is realistic.
